integrity: The theorem has a self-contained proof and a standalone finite/symbolic reproduction program. Finite tests are not universal proofs; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires one-dimensional state, exact infinite-horizon stationary LQR, finite plant support, common jointly stabilizing gain, strictly positive state penalties and positive-definite input costs.
No theorem about arbitrary-dimensional state or convergence of a particular policy-iteration implementation.
Possible earlier reformulation of the sharp curvature bound in classical LQR or quadratic-over-affine literature has not been excluded definitively.
source_ids: Pasdar and Adib Yaghmaie, Semidefinite Programming for Domain Randomization in LQR (ECC 2026)
title: A sharp heterogeneity-free convexity modulus for scalar-state domain-randomized LQR
